The Wildfowl & Wetlands Trust (WWT) said the five-year initiative would include more than 200 projects to restore and create wetlands across the city. These will range from small household rainwater ponds and street-level rain gardens to restoring river habitats, reconnecting rivers with their floodplains, and creating new wetlands. items.title: A global Microsoft 365 outage has hit millions – what happened and when will it be fixed?
items.desc: Problem affects businesses, government agencies and even tech firm’s own employees Microsoft scrambles to fix global outage affecting Teams and Outlook Microsoft outage – live updates Tell us: have you been affected by the Microsoft outage? Millions of people were unable to access their emails, Teams chats or meetings on Thursday night and Friday after a Microsoft 365 outage brought down services across the globe. The outage has lasted for more than 21 hours, with meaningful signs of recovery visible beginning shortly before midday GMT on Friday. It affected businesses, government agencies and even Microsoft employees all over the world. Those reporting issues have included the US House of Representatives, an Australian spy agency, airlines in India, European government agencies, and police services, ambulances and hospitals in the UK.
